description: Measure one element of a page on every device: size, position, visibility, font size, display, flex and grid settings. Shows how a component changes across breakpoints.

devices.description: Device ids or names from list_devices ("iphone-17", "Galaxy S26"), free-form sizes ("1024x768"), or a preset: default, popular, phones, latest, tablets, desktops, apple, foldables, extremes.

url.description: Page to load: a full URL, a bare host such as example.com, localhost:3000 for a local dev server, or a path to an HTML file

name: compare_element
